evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward through growth: 3.02→3.15→3.30→3.48 Torr, well above the ~3.0 Torr held earlier
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not commanded by flow
Temperature and heater power stable at setpoint 750 °C, so pressure rise is not thermal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified, so an air in-leak cannot be distinguished from an exhaust restriction

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2/leak-check channel, or a discriminating test such as briefly stepping Ar flow (or closing the precursor/inlet) while watching pressure: pressure that tracks flow indicates exhaust blockage, pressure that stays elevated at reduced flow indicates a seal leak.
